description: Customer-hosted, read-only MCP server for Jobber operations queries: owner action lists, overdue invoices, stale requests, estimates, jobs, and safe read-only GraphQL validation.

tools.name: jobber_auth_url
tools.description: Build a Jobber OAuth authorization URL for a customer-hosted install.

tools.name: jobber_exchange_code
tools.description: Exchange a Jobber OAuth authorization code and store tokens locally.

tools.name: jobber_refresh_token
tools.description: Refresh the locally stored Jobber access token.

tools.name: jobber_account
tools.description: Return the connected Jobber account id and name for install validation.

tools.name: jobber_clients_sample
tools.description: Return a small sample of Jobber clients to validate read access.

tools.name: jobber_graphql_read
tools.description: Run a read-only Jobber GraphQL query; mutations are blocked by default.
